full_prompt_en: The image is a square watercolor-and-ink storybook illustration of children studying something outdoors beside a stone wall and small camp kettle. The scene is set in a grassy clearing edged by dark leafy trees, with pale hills visible beyond the foliage. In the left foreground, a girl in a red checked pinafore over a pale blue blouse stands holding an open notebook. Near the center, a brown-haired child in a bright yellow shirt crouches low on a rock and writes or sketches in another open notebook. A boy in a light blue shirt and brown shorts stands behind them with a paper or book in his hands. Farther back at the right, two children lean over a small patch of ground near the stone wall, concentrating on their task. The weathered wall occupies the right edge; several colored bottles or containers sit on its top. Tall grass, small plants, scattered stones, and a narrow damp-looking ground area weave between the children. At the lower right, a dark kettle and brown container stand beside a thin plume of white steam or smoke. The composition has a slight downward viewpoint, letting the notebooks, rocks, and ground activity remain visible while trees frame the group. Soft daylight filters through the greenery, picking out the yellow shirt, red dress, pale pages, and the bright wisp near the kettle. Deep green foliage forms a shaded backdrop, but the grass and faces remain warm and clear. Loose transparent washes fill the landscape, while fine dark outlines and small dry-brush strokes articulate hair, clothing folds, grass, and stone. The picture fades into an irregular white paper margin, giving the busy gathering the warmth of an illustrated adventure page.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形水彩与墨线绘本插画：孩子们在石墙和小水壶旁观察户外事物。场景是一片草地空处，边缘有浓密暗叶树木，叶丛后露出浅色山坡。左侧前景，一位穿红格背带裙、内搭浅蓝衬衣的女孩站着，手里拿着打开的笔记本。中央附近，一位棕发、穿亮黄上衣的孩子低低蹲在石头上，在另一本打开的册子上写或画。他们后面，一位穿浅蓝衬衫和棕短裤的男孩站着，双手拿着纸或书。右侧更远处，两名孩子俯身靠近石墙边一小块地面，专注于手里的事。风化石墙占据右画边，墙顶放着几个彩色瓶或容器。高草、小植物、散石和一段略显湿润的地面在孩子之间穿插。右下角，一只暗水壶和棕容器立在一缕细白蒸汽或烟旁。构图视点略向下，让笔记本、石头和地上活动保持可见，树木同时框住人群。柔和日光穿过绿叶，照出黄上衣、红裙、浅纸页和水壶旁亮白细缕。深绿叶丛形成阴影背景，草地与面孔仍温暖清楚。松散透明的晕洗填入景观，细暗轮廓与短干笔描出头发、衣褶、草和石。画面向不规则白纸边晕去，使忙碌的聚集带有插图冒险故事页的温度。
style_prompt_en: Watercolor-and-ink storybook illustration combines transparent green and ochre washes with fine dark contours and brisk dry-brush detail. A shaded deep-green upper mass frames lighter grassy and cream areas below, while small red, yellow, and blue accents distribute attention among overlapping focal shapes. Fine scattered marks describe blades, rough edges, and fabriclike folds without losing the loose painted atmosphere. Diffuse outdoor light opens pale patches across the middle; deeper cool shadows remain beneath dense foliage. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, making multiple small activity zones readable in one compact scene. Edges soften and fade toward irregular white paper margins. The overall effect is lively, gentle, and hand-painted, with narrative detail carried by small precise marks inside broad washes.
style_prompt_zh: 水彩与墨线绘本插画把透明绿赭晕洗与细暗轮廓、轻快干笔细节结合。上方深绿阴影大块框住下方较浅的草绿与奶油色区域，少量红、黄、蓝色点缀把注意分给互相遮叠的焦点形状。细小散笔描出细条、粗边与衣料般褶面，又不失松散的绘画空气感。漫散户外光在中段打开浅亮片，较冷深影留在密集暗团之下。视点略高，使多个小活动区在紧凑场景中都可读。边缘变柔并退入不规则白纸边。整体活泼、温柔且有手绘感，叙事细节由宽晕洗中的准确小痕承担。
theme_en: Children studying something outdoors beside a stone wall and small camp kettle
theme_zh: 孩子们在石墙与小水壶旁观察户外事物
name: Enid Blyton
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
